description: This Scala source file defines an abstract class UDFRegistration for registering user-defined functions (UDFs) and user-defined aggregate functions (UDAFs) in Apache Spark SQL. It includes methods for registering UDFs of various arities, from 0 to 22 arguments, for both Scala and Java functions, with detailed documentation and code generation comments.

classes.name: UDFRegistration
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to register user-defined functions (UDFs) and aggregate functions (UDAFs) in Spark SQL, supporting various function signatures and Java/Scala interoperability.

methods.name: registerJava
methods.description: Registers a Java UDF class by its class name, implementing UDF interfaces in the Java package.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a Scala or Java UDF or UDAF with a specified name, supporting multiple argument counts and types.

methods.name: registerScalaUDF
methods.description: Creates and registers a Scala UDF from a function and its type tags.

methods.name: registerJavaUDF
methods.description: Creates and registers a Java UDF with validation.
